F.2 Each flat refusal (a no with no date and no amount) moves to the next step of the ladder: 1. the full overdue amount on the deadline; 2. half the overdue amount, rounded up to the next whole euro (a whole-euro result stays), on the deadline; if that is below the floor, the floor instead; 3. the floor on the deadline. F.4 Stop proposing when the product's persuasion limit is reached or the ladder has no steps left, whichever comes first.

F.3 Never make the same proposal twice in a call. A step whose amount and date are both identical to a proposal already made for that product (the opening question included) is skipped.
